examples.en: On rainy days I think of kimchi pancakes.

examples.ko: 김치전을 부칠 때는 기름을 넉넉히 둘러요.
examples.en: When you pan-fry kimchi pancakes, use plenty of oil.
If you add onion to the kimchi pancake, it gets sweeter.
We dip kimchi pancakes in soy sauce.

examples.ko: 우리 김치전 한 장 더 시킬까요?
examples.en: Shall we order one more kimchi pancake?
I had a kimchi pancake together with bean sprout soup.

explain: 김치를 넣어 얇게 부친 음식이에요. 만들 때는 '굽다'보다 '부치다'를 써서 '전을 부치다'라고 해요. '김치부침개'도 같은 음식을 가리키는 말이에요.

phrases.en: I made kimchi pancakes with my family on the weekend.
phrases.nuance_en: Remember that pancakes like this use '부치다', not '굽다'.

phrases.en: My mom made kimchi pancakes for me.
phrases.nuance_en: Another name for the same dish as '김치전'.

phrases.en: I dip the kimchi pancake in soy sauce and eat it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 먹는 방법을 말할 때 자주 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common phrase describing how the dish is eaten.
phrases.en_equiv: to dip kimchi pancake in soy sauce

explain_en: It is a thin pancake pan-fried with kimchi. When making it, you say '전을 부치다' rather than '굽다'. '김치부침개' is another name for the same dish.

examples.en: I fell asleep watching TV in the living room.

examples.ko: 티브이 소리가 너무 커서 이야기를 못 했어요.
examples.en: The TV was so loud that we couldn't talk.
I heard today's weather news on TV.

examples.ko: 티브이는 밥 먹을 때 끄는 게 좋아요.
examples.en: It's better to turn the TV off when eating.

examples.ko: 새 티브이로 바꿨더니 화면이 훨씬 선명해요.
examples.en: I switched to a new TV and the picture is much clearer.

explain: '텔레비전'을 줄여 한글로 쓴 말로, 영어 TV를 읽은 소리예요. 말할 때는 '티비'라고도 많이 하는데, 글에서는 '티브이'나 'TV'로 써요. '티브이를 보다/켜다/끄다'처럼 함께 써요.

phrases.nuance_ko: 말할 때 많이 쓰는 형태이고, 글에서는 '티브이'나 'TV'로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common spoken form; in writing use '티브이' or 'TV'.

phrases.nuance_ko: 줄이지 않은 원래 말로, 조금 더 격식 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: The full, unshortened word, a bit more formal.

phrases.en: When I get home, I turn on the TV first.
phrases.nuance_en: Good to learn together with '끄다' (turn off).

explain_en: It is the Hangul spelling of the sound of English 'TV', short for '텔레비전'. In speech people often say '티비', but in writing it is '티브이' or 'TV'. It pairs with verbs as in '티브이를 보다/켜다/끄다'.
